note: 30 real support questions supplied 2026-11-18. Verticals are inferred by inspection, not confirmed by the business. expected_chunk_ids / expected_facts are intentionally empty: fill them from the actual databanks before scoring. Several questions are deictic (هالثوب، دا المقاس، الويكند، بكره) and cannot be answered from the current message alone - that is direct evidence for P1's history-aware query.
